page.overview:
What is Great Intelligence?

The Great Intelligence is a fictional cosmic entity created for the science fiction TV series Doctor Who in the 1967 serial The Abominable Snowmen. Some sources in the Doctor Who expanded universe equate this entity with Yog-Sothoth. (: All-Consuming Fire, Millennial Rites)

The Great Intelligence is a malevolent disembodied intelligence perhaps originating from another dimension or universe, although in its original appearances it is explicitly extraterrestrial in origin, "floating about in space". It can take over the bodies of humans and manifest itself as a web-like material. Although its exact motivations are unclear, it desires to conquer Earth, and has employed armies of Robot Yeti to try to subjugate humanity. These robots contain metallic spheres inside their bodies, which provide a direct link to the mind of the Intelligence.

The physical manifestation of the Great Intelligence in our universe (outside of its Robot Yeti and the people whose minds have been possessed by it) usually takes the form of a web-like substance that can be generated on land, sky, or outer space, and is even capable of immobilising a Time Lord's TARDIS in mid-flight. This web also seems to have the biological properties of a fungus.

Additionally, the Great Intelligence can also manifest itself as a slime-like fluid, a dense fog that can engulf and absorb victims, or even as information in a computer network. (: The Abominable Snowmen, The Web of Fear, Downtime)
